No. NASA FIRMS recorded no thermal detections intersecting this property (ASSET-F07) between 2026-09-26 and 2026-10-26. The count was 0. All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day of the period, so the absence of detections isn't a coverage gap.

This doesn't prove that no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires can go undetected. The evidence also says nothing about burned area, the cause of any change on the property (harvest, fire, storm, clearing), or anything outside this period.

The data reflects what was known as of 2026-11-12. A detection counted if its footprint (375 m for VIIRS, 1 km for MODIS) intersected the property boundary.
